v1.0.5.description:
### Bug Fixes
- Critical bug fixed that was caused by the previous version, where towers were not spawned until you activated the Great Plateau tower.
  - To get around this, the Great Plateau now starts out with its map revealed and the tower activated. However, you will still follow logic by only doing Great Plateau checks once you've received the Great Plateau Tower item.
    - Subsequently, the Great Plateau Tower location check has been removed, as there's no point in climbing it now.
- Fixed Divine Beast warp points not being activated upon entering them.
v1.0.5.title: v1.0.5

v1.1.0.description:
## Additions
- Added Trial of the Sword checks for section completions (Beginning, Middle, and Final) and chests.
- Added items for Divine Beast Controls which gate Divine Beast access (one for each Divine Beast, along with the Final Trial).
- Added YAML shuffle options for shrine chests, recovered memories, and Trial of the Sword.
- Added a YAML option for randomizing the starting tower. If disabled (default), you will start with the Great Plateau Tower. If enabled, one of 12 of the 15 towers will be chosen that offer Sphere 1 checks in their region.
- Added a YAML toggle for each of the two DLCs, which will enable/disable items and locations exclusive to their respective DLC.
  - When their respective DLCs are disabled, `Progressive Master Sword` and `Progressive <Champion Ability>` become simply `Master Sword` and `<Champion Ability>`.
## Other Changes
- A Switch version of the save file is now provided. For any releases from now on, both a Wii U and a Switch version of the save will be available.
- Updated instructions to include which flags correspond to which towers, in case a player would prefer to just enable and warp to them instead of using coordinates. Note that logic will still expect that you have what would be needed to climb them, if applicable.
## Bug Fixes
- Brought the Great Plateau Tower location back, as it is actually needed for progression to be possible upon starting with the Great Plateau Tower, and was causing generation to fail. The tower is already activated upon starting, so you can either still climb it, or just send the location.
v1.1.0.title: v1.1.0
